page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6e-c12g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor and an x86_64 architecture. It features 48 dedicated physical cores utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 368.0 GB of system memory, providing 7.67 GB per core. For acceleration, it bundles four NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs with a combined total of 128 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage and relies on network-attached storage, supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core CPU performance via stress-ng is rated as weak, and single-threaded gzip compression is poor. However, multi-core CPU performance and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reach average tiers, reflecting the high core count. Memory bandwidth is stable, with read-only small block cached speeds at 1975.99 GB/sec and large block uncached write speeds at 47.39 GB/sec. Redis SET operations achieve an average of 33.18 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput reaches 23.02 GB/sec.

The qualitative cost profile of this instance is defined by its high resource density, particularly the inclusion of four enterprise-grade GPUs and a large memory footprint, which positions it as a premium tier resource. The primary tradeoff is the lack of local storage, requiring external storage configurations, alongside lower single-core performance. This hardware profile is suited for workloads that can leverage parallel GPU processing and high memory capacity, such as deep learning training, parallel scientific computing, and GPU-accelerated database operations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6e-c12g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for parallel computing workloads. It features 48 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 physical cores running at 2.5 GHz, 368.0 GB of RAM, and four NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs providing 128 GB of total VRAM. The instance does not include local storage and provides a 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark data shows weak single-core CPU performance but average multi-core and multi-threaded decompression capabilities. Memory bandwidth is average, with uncached large block reads at 98.85 GB/sec. Given its high resource density and lack of local storage, this instance represents a specialized hardware profile. It is best suited for GPU-intensive workloads, deep learning, and parallel data processing tasks that benefit from dedicated accelerators and substantial system memory.
